goal: Phase 1d (plan-eval-cases) of campaign adversarial-planner: faberun plan accepts --runtimes <catalogue.json> so a caller declares the runtime catalogue the planning pipeline uses (the frozen contract carries it), and three deterministic eval cases on the replay harness prove no-autostart, contested and detached. Supersedes node plan-eval-cases of contract 1b, whose write scope missed src/cli/plan.mjs. Spec: docs/campaigns/adversarial-planner/spec/SPEC.md.

definitionOfDone.text: D23 passes: frozen plan, contract present, no run directory
D24 passes: contested, no contract, findings named
D25 passes: detached pipeline completes after its launcher dies
every case, the new three included, fails under its discriminator mutation
plan, command-surface and manual tests pass with the --runtimes flag
npm run docs:check finds the manual current
the three guarantees are proven by cases that would fail if the guarantee broke, driven through the real CLI with a declared runtime catalogue

taskPacket.objective: faberun plan gains --runtimes <path> (a JSON catalogue in the contract's runtimes shape, replacing the built-in discovery definitions, validated the same way and carried into every stage contract and the frozen contract), and three deterministic eval cases on the replay harness prove the planner's guarantees -- D23 a frozen plan never autostarts, D24 a contested plan emits no contract and names its findings, D25 a detached planning pipeline survives the death of the process that launched it -- each with a discriminator mutation, run by node evals/run.mjs --case D23|D24|D25.
instructions: Evidence: evals/deterministic/D01..D22 are contract-driven cases (case.json with contract, recordings, setup, discriminator; evals/case.mjs materializeCase; evals/run.mjs runs the contract and compares with expected.json). The planner is driven by a command, not a contract, so evals/run.mjs needs a case kind that runs `faberun plan` with replay runtimes; read evals/README.md and evals/case.mjs first.

A first attempt of this node (contract 1b) found that src/cli/plan.mjs:84 hardcodes `runtimes: DISCOVERY_RUNTIME_DEFINITIONS`, so no command-kind case can reach the replay harness, and that --runtime-defaults ids must be keys of that same catalogue (composeAssignments in src/engine/runtime-discovery.mjs). Change 0, src/cli/plan.mjs and src/cli.mjs COMMAND_OPTIONS: add `--runtimes <path>`; when given, read the JSON, validate it with the contract's runtime validator (src/contract/runtime.mjs), and pass it as the pipeline's runtimes catalogue in place of the built-in definitions; --runtime-defaults ids are then resolved against it. Update the manual's authored prose for the flag and run npm run docs; add a test to test/cli/plan.test.mjs that a catalogue file with replay runtimes drives the pipeline end to end. The eval cases then pass a case-local catalogue file whose entries use harness replay backed by the case's recordings.

Change 1, evals/case.mjs and evals/run.mjs: a case whose case.json carries `command: {argv: [...], env?: {...}}` instead of `contract` is materialised the same way (temp git repo, recordings on the replay harness) and run through src/cli.mjs with that argv; expected.json may assert files that exist or do not exist under the temp repo (`expectPaths: {present: [...], absent: [...]}`) and JSON fields of plan.json. Keep --assert-no-model and --verify-discriminating working for the new kind (the discriminator mutates a recording or a flag). Introduce `runPlanCase` as the runner for the command kind.

Change 2, the three cases: D23 (title 'a frozen plan never launches its contract'): recordings for draft and review, expected plan.json status frozen, contract.json present, and no .runs/<contract id>/ directory; discriminator: a recording that also creates the run directory would fail. D24 ('a contested plan emits no contract and names its findings'): every review recording returns a critical finding, --review-rounds 1, expected status contested, contract.json absent, findings listed, open-question in the journal. D25 ('a detached planning pipeline survives its launcher'): run `plan --detach`, kill the launching process once the bootstrap record exists (through the case's setup hook, never a raw kill of the test runner's own group), wait for plan.json, expected status frozen. No wall-clock bounds from above.

Change 3: evals/README.md gains a paragraph on command cases; `node evals/run.mjs --verify-fixtures` and `--validate-golden` must keep passing (evals/golden is never edited; if the golden set needs the new cases, follow the README's build-golden procedure and report what it changed).
decisions: Command cases reuse the deterministic class and its discriminator discipline.
Numeric ids keep the repository's convention; the proposal's D-plan names are the titles.
nonGoals: No live model. No edit to evals/golden by hand.

No edit to skills/faberun/references/{rules,engineering,workflow,handoffs,contract,operations}.md, docs/history/**, evals/golden/**, or any existing file under docs/campaigns/**. CONTRACT_VERSION stays 0.3.0.
No file over 800 lines: extend by adding a module or test file, never by growing one past the ceiling.
Do not run the full suite yourself; the controller runs your verification after you declare done. Quick targeted test files are fine.
No new test depends on the wall clock, on a binary in PATH, or on the machine layout; no fixture shebang through /usr/bin/env node; no live model in any test or eval (replay harness only).

Every new src/ module starts with a header comment saying what it owns and why it is separate; git only through the bounded helpers already in the tree; any new persisted field goes with its validator allowlist and typedef.
